Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

In this role, you will ensure the precise finishing of aluminium profiles and frames. You will alternate between series production ans custom-made pieces, with quality always being the top priority. You'll receive a salary starting at €17.50 per hour, depending on your experience, supplemented by meal vouchers.

Do you enjoy working precisely with metal and do you derive satisfaction from a perfectly finished end product? Then be sure to read on!

What does your day look like as a grinder?

 
• 
You will grind and deburr aluminium profiles in accordance with the technical drawings

 
• 
You carry out visual quality checks on your own grinding work

 
• 
You alternate between series production and custom-made pieces

 
• 
You process production orders via an ERP system

 
• 
You follow quality through control sheets

 
• 
You carry out first-line maintenance, e.g. replacing sanding brushes, maintaining work equipment, etc.

Do you already have experience as a metalworker or do you already have knowledge of an ERP system ? This is definitely a plus!

 
• 
You're good at reading technical drawings and enjoy working with precision

 
• 
You're good working with measuring tools

 
• 
You're quality-oriented and value order and tidiness

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
• 
A job in 2 shifts is just what you're looking for, and do you already have experience in

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

For a leading company in the events industry, Let's Work is looking for a CNC Milling Machine Operator to work in a 2-shift system. You will join a technically challenging role with plenty of variety, where precision and quality are key.

What will your responsibilities be as a CNC Milling Machine Operator?

 
• 
Mill aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and specifications

 
• 
Alternate between series production and custom work, providing plenty of variety in your job

 
• 
For new parts, create milling programs and correctly set up the machine

 
• 
Load and unload the milling machine and monitor the production process

 
• 
Check the quality of your work using measuring tools such as a vernier caliper and tape measure

 
• 
Monitor quality using inspection sheets and process production orders in the ERP system

 
• 
Carry out first-line maintenance of the machine

 
• 
You have experience as a CNC milling machine operator 

 
• 
You can easily read technical drawings and accurately take measurements using measuring instruments

 
• 
Knowledge of ERP systems is a strong advantage

 
• 
You work accurately and with a strong focus on quality, and you pay attention to order and cleanliness

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system fits perfectly with your work routine

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

Are you experienced in operating sawing machines and working with aluminium profiles? As a Saw Operator, you will cut aluminium profiles according to technical drawings and ensure that every piece meets the required quality standards.

You will work in a modern production environment in Roeselare, alternating between series production, one-off production and special pieces. You will work in a 2-shift system and use an ERP system to process production orders.

Your main tasks include:

 
• 
Reading technical drawings and determining how the pieces need to be cut.

 
• 
Setting up the sawing machine, including the required lengths and cutting angles.

 
• 
Cutting aluminium profiles for series production, one-off production and special pieces.

 
• 
Checking your own work using gauges and measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
Recording quality checks on inspection sheets.

 
• 
Processing production orders in the ERP system Business Central – Propos.

 
• 
Communicating relevant information during shift handovers.

 
• 
Carrying out first-line maintenance, such as cleaning the machine and replacing saw blades.

 
• 
Supporting other workstations when necessary.

 
• 
You have experience as a Operator.

 
• 
You can read technical drawings related to sawing and cutting components.

 
• 
You can work with measuring tools such as a tape measure and caliper.

 
• 
You can speak English. This is a requirement for the position.

 
• 
Basic knowledge of Dutch, both spoken and written, is an advantage.

 
• 
Working in a 2-shift system suits you.

 
• 
You work accurately and check the quality of your own work.

 
• 
You keep your workplace clean and organised.

 
• 
Experience with an ERP system is an advantage.

Perhaps you found this vacancy thanks to our software? Because that’s what theMatchBox does: we build smart search engines that match the right job with the right candidate – or vice versa. By making clever use of a whole range of artificial intelligence tools – such as natural language processing, ontologies and large language models – we take into account spelling variations, typos, synonyms, context and everything else needed to compile, in a transparent manner, a list of matching jobs and candidates that is as accurate and comprehensive as possible.
 

theMatchBox is part of the Pixid Group and is a fast-growing HR tech scale-up with clients including staffing agencies, job sites and major employers both at home and abroad. Do you enjoy getting to grips with complex issues and would you like to play your part in improving the functioning of the labour market? Then come and join our team, as we could really do with your help.
 

Your tasks will be very varied. You’ll work on the API and the architecture of our matching software. In consultation with our account managers, you’ll integrate our software with the client’s systems so that all necessary data becomes searchable in our matching engine. Together with the client, you’ll determine which aspects of a job or candidate are important to them when making a match and configure our software accordingly. Finally, you’ll be part of our support team or resolve build issues… Everything is done in close collaboration and consultation with the team, and you’re always welcome to pop in and see us.

Together with the client, you will determine which aspects of a job or candidate are important to them for a match and configure our software accordingly. Finally, you will work within our support system or fix build issues… Everything is done in close collaboration and consultation with the team, and you can always come to us with your ideas.
 

What do we expect from you? 
• You have a thorough knowledge of Java, 
• You have experience designing or maintaining a software architecture, 
• You enjoy navigating our complex software and algorithms, 
• You are interested in search engines and artificial intelligence, 
• When programming, you value accuracy, quality, and security, 
• You enjoy working independently (we will, of course, help you get started), 
• You can communicate clearly with clients and colleagues, 
• You can express yourself well in English.
 

What is not necessary but is nice to have? 
• Experience with Docker, Elasticsearch, 
• Experience deploying LLMs on GPUs, 
• Building software with Maven and Jenkins, 
• Managing servers with Ansible.

As a Laser Operator, you will operate advanced laser cutting machines used to cut metal sheets and tubes to specification. You will monitor the quality of the production process and ensure operations run safely and efficiently.

Your responsibilities:

 
• Setting up and operating laser cutting machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Performing quality checks on finished components.
 
• Identifying and resolving minor machine issues.
 
• Contributing to a safe and organized workplace.

 
• You have a technical education or a strong interest in technology.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

As a Press Brake Operator, you will be responsible for accurately bending metal parts based on technical drawings. You ensure that every component meets the required quality standards.

Your tasks:

 
• Setting up and operating CNC press brake machines.
 
• Reading and interpreting technical drawings.
 
• Checking the quality and dimensions of finished parts.
 
• Making minor adjustments where necessary.
 
• Maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

 
• You have a technical background or a strong technical affinity.
 
• Experience in metalworking or mechanical manufacturing is a plus.
 
• Motivated school leavers are also welcome to apply.
 
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality.
 
• You speak Dutch well. Candidates with a strong technical profile and a good command of English are also encouraged to apply.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.

Unique is looking for a Mechanic to work on trailers over 7.5 tonnes in Gullegem.
 
 
 
• Maintenance of semi-trailers, trailers and low loaders over 7.5 tonnes (NO SMALL TRAILERS) 
 
• Preparation and inspection of semi-trailers, trailers and low loaders 
 
• Diagnosis 
 
• Replacing brakes, air bellows, shock absorbers 
 
• Replacing air valves, reading and repairing EBS problems 
 
• Aligning trailers 
 
• Repairing lighting 
 
• Repairing bodywork on semi-trailers, trailers and flatbed trailers 
 
• Repairing accidents 
 
• Repairs loading bridges: electrical and mechanical 
 
• Repair of hydraulic problems on low loaders and tail lifts 
 
• Recovery orders 

 
 
• You can work in a 2-shift system (7 am to 5 pm and 9 am to 7 pm) 
 
• You are flexible to work on Saturday mornings every 2 weeks 
 
• You have a good knowledge of Dutch or French or English 
 
• Education: A3 or A2 automotive (mechanics) technical or professional, equivalent fields or knowledge through experience 
 
• Knowledge: basis of mechanics and/or vehicle electrics and/or hydraulics and/or pneumatics, among others.

• 
You will drive and operate the Terberg truck for goods handling and truck operations.

 
• 
You will drive the trailers to the loading and unloading docks and transport them within the industrial park.

 
• 
Ensure safe and efficient internal transport of goods.

 
• 
You will sometimes assist in the warehouse: loading, unloading, receiving, driving the forklift.

 
• 
Work within rotating shifts: 06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00 (two shifts).

 
• 
Previous truck driving experience or CE license is required.

 
• 
Proficiency in English (and/or Dutch) is necessary for effective communication.

 
• 
Comfortable working in a rotating shifts.

 
• 
Safety-conscious, motivated, and reliable.

We are hiring! For an international global player in the logistics sector (Puurs / Antwerp region), we are currently looking for a driven 
GL Accountant. Are you ready to perform at Champions League level in a dynamic environment where ownership and change are key?
 
 

•  

Location: Puurs / Antwerp region
  

•  

Company Culture: The bar is set high, but in return, you get a huge amount of freedom and autonomy.
  

•  

Team: You will join the Regional Shared Service Center (RSSC) for Benelux, a team of 30 accountants. The RSSC serves as an internal pilot within the international group: all accounting and controlling activities are centralized and optimized here.
   

Interested? Discover the job details below:
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

•  

End-to-End closing: Taking full responsibility for the timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings from A to Z for your assigned international entities.
  

•  

Financial integrity: Ensuring financial reliability by performing complex balance sheet analyses and in-depth reconciliations.
  

•  

Reporting: Delivering accurate internal and external financial reports on time, in compliance with both local regulations (BE GAAP) and IFRS.
  

•  

Audit & compliance: Serving as the central operational point of contact for both internal and external auditors, and proactively safeguarding internal compliance controls.
  

•  

Process optimization: Actively contributing to the continuous improvement and streamlining of accounting processes within the Regional SSC, and proactively sharing knowledge within the team.
  

•  

Business partnering: Maintaining close internal contacts with the controlling team, which provides support during the closing process and performs deep-dive analyses.
  

Qualifications
 
 

•  

Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  

•  

Experience: Dynamic accountant with strong experience in General Ledger (GL) accounting, preferably gained in a complex, changing, or international corporate environment.
  

•  

Knowledge & systems:
 
 

•  

In-depth and proven knowledge of BE GAAP and IFRS.
  

•  

Excellent systems knowledge: experience with 
SAP S/4HANA and 
Excel is an absolute must. Knowledge of Power BI is a strong asset.
    

•  

Languages: Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  

•  

Essentials:
 
 

•  

Autonomous, proactive, able to structure your own work, and only satisfied when the result is delivered.
  

•  

Resilient, thriving in a dynamic, transforming environment where structures and processes evolve rapidly.
  

•  

Strong, direct, and open communicator regarding what goes well, but also brave enough to discuss mistakes to learn together.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

On behalf of our client working in the Financial Services Industry, we are look for a Credit Risk Analyst that will help assessing project viabilities and predictive model development and optimization : 

• In credit risk model analysis and maintainance 
• Code development and code testing to put in place new predictive models into the system 
• Ensuring good communication flows with Banking regulators

About You :

• Master in an Analytics, Statistical, or Finance oriented field 
• Well versed in Microsoft Excel, Access
• Well versed in analytical tools like Python, R, SAS…
• Analytical character and an eye for detail 
• Perfectly fluent in Dutch with a good grasp of English and French

jobs.occupation: Microsoft Dynamics Consultant - Business Services - Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you looking to work on large-scale digital transformation projects with a national impact? Do you enjoy bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technology while continuously developing your expertise? This opportunity could be the perfect next step in your career.

As a Business Analyst Microsoft Dynamics 365, you will support clients in analyzing, optimizing, and transforming their business processes through innovative ERP and CRM solutions.Your responsibilities will include:

• Gathering and analyzing business requirements from key stakeholders.
• Leading workshops and translating business needs into functional specifications.
• Supporting the implementation and optimization of Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions.
• Acting as the liaison between business teams, consultants, and technical experts.
• Coordinating testing activities and ensuring successful user adoption.
• Contributing to complex, large-scale digital transformation programmes.

Profile

• Experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, ERP Consultant, or a similar role.
• Good understanding of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations, Business Central, Customer Engagement, or related modules).
• Strong analytical and communication skills.
• Comfortable interacting with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Fluent in French and Dutch, with a good command of English.

jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Intern – B2B Food Supplements
jobs.description:
Who we areFermedics is a Ghent-based scale-up making fermented botanical ingredients for food supplement brands. And we’re growing fast: in recent years we’ve roughly doubled every year. We’re riding two big waves at once, a booming supplements market and the fermentation trend. Small team, big ambitions, short communication lines. 
Your missionHelp us build a real digital marketing strategy. The basics are already there: our website, LinkedIn, Semrush for SEO/GEO analysis, newsletters and Canva. Now we need someone to bring it all together, including a content plan for our newsletter, Instagram and LinkedIn communication. 
What you’ll be doing
 
 

• SEO & GEO: dig into Semrush, spot the gaps and fix them, so both Google and LLM models like Claude & ChatGPT find us 

• Sales funnel & Campaigns: map out our funnel and set up campaigns across channels and drive conversions 

• Website: improve findability, structure and conversion 

• Content: social posts, blog posts, mailings and website copy 

• Instagram: yes, B2B. Our customers (supplement brands) are there, so we should be too. You’ll launch and grow our account 

• Influencers: get relevant influencers on board to boost our reach and visibility 

• Showcasing finished products: plan how we highlight products made with our ingredients across the website, LinkedIn and Instagram 

• Visuals: create eye-catching marketing material 
 

• A student or recent graduate in (digital) marketing, communication or a related field 

• Digital native: you know social media, content and SEO, and you’re curious about AI search 

• Strong writer in English (Dutch is a plus) 

• Creative, hands-on and independent; you like to own your projects 

• Interested in health, food (supplements) or science? Then you’ll like it here!

Are you an experienced .NET DevOps Engineer with strong skills in ASP.NET Core and Azure DevOps pipelines ?

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET DevOps Engineer to join a dynamic platform team working in a large-scale Agile IT environment.

The team works transversally across the organization and focuses on making the Azure Cloud platform accessible, scalable and easy to use for other development teams. You will work in a multidisciplinary team following Agile, Scrum and SAFe methodologies.
Role
• Design, develop and maintain reusable .NET components using C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Design, develop and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD components using C#, PowerShell, YAML pipelines and Bicep.
• Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, Product Owners and Scrum Masters in a SAFe environment.
• Participate in PI Planning and other Agile ceremonies.
• Analyze and resolve technical issues and bugs.
• Perform code reviews and ensure high-quality code through unit and integration testing.
• Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing.
• Provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to less experienced colleagues.
• Continuously improve development processes, software quality and technical solutions.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and industry best practices.
Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Solid experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Cloud.
• Experience with CI/CD, YAML pipelines, PowerShell and Bicep.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong technical coaching and mentoring abilities.
• Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset
 
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with:

• WCF
• Blazor
• gRPC
• GitHub EnterpriseLanguages
• Dutch or French: Native level
• Second national language (Dutch or French): Basic written and spoken communication
• English: Good comprehension.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
